course.department: Department of Urban and Regional Planning

content.value: Trucks of a company arrive at a transhipment centre to be unloaded in a pattern which is characterised by the poison distribution. The average rate of arrival is 45 per hour. A set of attendants unload the trucks, and the level of service is 100 per hour on an average. The drivers make BDT 16 per hour and the set of attendants are pain BDT 10 per hour.
(i) How much expense, on the average, is incurred by the company for idle time on part of each drivers each time he is at the transhipment centre?
(ii)Find the optimum number or sets of attendants to be employed for transhipment.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2017
